schema_notes.purpose: Autocomplete/search catalog plus storage-generation metadata for modular drawer organization.
important: The catalog separates semantic storage intent from current backend manufacturing capability.
The backend currently implements only five generator kinds: divided_bin, cylindrical_pockets, hex_pockets, rectangular_pockets, and spool.
storage.strategy describes ideal storage behavior; generation.backend_generator describes the geometry backend/generators.py can actually build now.
generation.support_level is native, parameterized, or fallback.
Fallback objects are still manufacturable: unsupported specialized geometry resolves to a bounding-box rectangular pocket or generic divided bin.
Conceptual templates such as tool_contour and cable_coil_bay are retained for future compatibility but must not be treated as implemented CadQuery generators.
Do not size containers from average volume alone; use geometry, quantity_mode, packing_factor, nesting/bundle metadata, and generation.sizing_mode.
Customer grouping remains semantic and independent of physical container generation.
For unknown or highly variable objects, prefer user measurements or image segmentation over catalog averages.
Customer inventory should keep actual_quantity separate from desired_capacity.

quantity_modes.individual: Each physical item is counted and normally receives its own capacity contribution.
quantity_modes.bulk: Many loose items share one compartment; total volume and packing factor drive sizing.
quantity_modes.set: Quantity refers to sets; each set may contain multiple pieces that are stored together.
quantity_modes.nested: Items nest; stack size is driven by first-item footprint plus incremental nesting height.
quantity_modes.bundle: Multiple long/flexible items are stored together in a shared channel or bundle.

divided_bin.description: Rectangular bin with one or more compartments/divisions.

cylindrical_pockets.description: Circular/cylindrical pockets arranged for one or more objects.

hex_pockets.description: Hexagonal pockets arranged for one or more objects.

rectangular_pockets.description: Rectangular pockets sized from object or group geometry.

spool.description: Spool-oriented storage geometry for flexible material.

backend_capabilities.rule: Every catalog object must resolve to exactly one implemented backend generator kind.

fallback_policy.description: Unsupported specialized strategies retain their semantic metadata but generate a safe bounding-box or generic divided-bin container.

support_levels.native: Existing backend geometry closely represents the intended storage form.
support_levels.parameterized: Existing primitive is reused, but strategy-specific sizing/orientation/nesting behavior is still honored.
support_levels.fallback: Specialized geometry is not implemented; backend produces a safe generic container instead.

contour.fallback_reason: No silhouette/contour CadQuery generator exists yet.

coil.fallback_reason: No rounded coil-bay CadQuery generator exists yet.

bottle.fallback_reason: No dedicated bottle-holder generator exists yet.

divider.fallback_reason: Uses the generic divided-bin primitive rather than an adaptive utensil/divider tray.
